query:
WITH args AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM UNNEST(
        $1::UUID[],
        $2::UUID[],
        $3::INTEGER[]
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS o(extraction_id, chunk_id, ordinal, ord)
),
objs AS (
    INSERT INTO rev.asset_extraction_chunks (extraction_id, chunk_id, ordinal)
    SELECT args.extraction_id, args.chunk_id, args.ordinal
    FROM args
    ORDER BY args.ord
    RETURNING extraction_id, chunk_id, ordinal
)
SELECT extraction_id, chunk_id, ordinal
FROM objs
ORDER BY extraction_id, ordinal;
